paper_title: VisuoThink Empowering LVLM Reasoning with Multimodal Tree Search
caption: The performance gain (+%) on tasks through predictive rollout search. The performance gain is calculated via the performance gap between VisuoThink (w/o rollout search) and VisuoThink.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain in percentage achieved under strong and weak supervision for different models. The horizontal axis contains categories labeled as "GPT-4o", "Claude-3.5-Sonnet", and "Qwen2-72B-VL", and appears to be arranged in no particular order. The vertical axis represents the "Performance Gain (+%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, marked at intervals of 5 percent. Each category includes two bars, grouped together, with the "Strong Supervision" bar patterned with stripes and the "Weak Supervision" bar solid, both colored in shades of blue. For "GPT-4o", the strong supervision bar reaches approximately 24%, while the weak supervision bar is around 5%. For "Claude-3.5-Sonnet," the strong supervision bar is about 9%, and the weak supervision bar is close to 4%. For "Qwen2-72B-VL", the strong supervision bar measures approximately 15%, and the weak supervision bar is around 5%. The bars are neither sorted in a specific numeric order nor visually emphasized with any additional shading or outlines, beyond their consistent format. A legend is available on top of the plot to map different styles of bar to their group ("Strong Supervision" and "Weak Supervision").
